item.title: The Assembly of Lovers - Sufi Drum Circle — Mon Aug 31, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description: Community drum and chant circle rooted in Sufi prayer. Contribution: Sliding scale donation $20–$40 (no one will be turned away) This is a vibrant Community Drum and Chanting Circle, where we drum and chant from our hearts into the universe. This experience is open to absolutely everyone, regardless of background or belief system—all that’s required is an open heart and a willingness to connect through sound. The term ‘lover’ in this context refers to seekers on the Sufi path who are longing for union with the divine energy. You can think of this gathering as an expansion of the sema sufi meditations we used to offer. It is looser in form, more focused on music, and does not necessarily involve whirling, although it is welcome if you are called to it. There is a rhythm older than thought. item.description:
Tuesday Night Figure Drawing – Open Studio *Cover art by Ling Chen.
Tuesday night at The Space is your invitation to drop in, find your creative flow, and feel good. Each week a different nude model serves as our muse as we pursue creative expression through observation and mark making. We challenge how we see and what we want to say — observing the nuances of the human form, its moods, character, and light — and do our best to capture something in the moment that tells a story. This has become a tight-knit, supportive community of seekers — artists, experimenters, and curious souls drawn together by the shared pursuit of capturing the living human form. Use the time to refine your skills, experiment with different media, and deepen your understanding of anatomy, gesture, and proportion. item.title: Oratorio Society of New Jersey Calls for Singers — Tue Sep 1, 7:30 PM — Union Congregational Church
item.description: The Oratorio Society of New Jersey (OSNJ) will begin rehearsals for their 2026-27 season on Tuesday, September 1, at Union Congregational Church in Montclair, and is looking for singers in all vocal parts to join the choir. For the fall season, OSNJ will present Felix Mendelssohn’s monumental Elijah. The concert will take place on Saturday, November 14th, in Montclair. Choral singers have loved performing Mendelssohn’s Elijah since its premiere in 1846 in Birmingham, England. According to writer Steph Martin, “For many conductors, performers and listeners, it is the perfect oratorio, combining all the dramatic musical elements required to bring this colourful story to life.” The musicologist R. item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Sep 9, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Reimagining the Tarot: An Intuitive Collage Workshop — Sun Sep 27, 12:30 PM
item.description: What if the Tarot could speak in your voice? In this exploratory workshop, we’ll dive into the rich history and symbolism of the Major Arcana — exploring the colors, archetypes, and allegories that have given these iconic cards their power for centuries. Then, we’ll turn that wisdom over to your own creative instincts. No art experience needed. No tarot experience needed. Just an open mind and a willingness to listen to what’s stirring inside you. You’ll choose a card that calls to you, journal your reflections, and then bring it to life through drawing, painting, or collage — reimagining it through your own symbols, style, and personal expression. The goal isn’t perfection; it’s presence.
